title: Tapping the gym's 'changed your workout plan' or 'saved your measurements' pop-up can open the old copy
what: The pop-up says 'Tap to see it'. The tap opens the Workout tab or the Body page, but the phone asks the gym again only if it has not asked in the last 10 minutes, and the Workout tab asks only when the member switches to it, not when the app comes back from the background. A member who had the app open at the gym a few minutes before the trainer saved the plan or the measurements taps the pop-up and still sees the old plan or no new measurements, with nothing saying more is coming. The Workout tab has no pull to refresh that forces a fresh ask.
expected: Opening the app from one of these pop-ups always asks the gym again at once, so the member sees what the pop-up named.
who: members of gyms that send plans or record measurements
how_often: when the trainer saves within 10 minutes of the member opening the app
fix_line: When the app opens from a gym pop-up, ask the gym again straight away instead of waiting out the 10 minutes

title: A forgotten workout keeps a running clock in the notification shade for hours or days while the app is closed
what: The forgotten-workout pause only runs while the app is on screen. A member who leaves the gym without tapping Finish and puts the phone away keeps the workout card in the notification shade, and its clock keeps counting up (3:40:00, then 20 hours) because the phone counts it by itself. Nothing reminds the member the workout is still open. The saved length is put right only when the app is opened again.
expected: After an hour with no sets, the card in the shade stops its clock and says the workout paused itself, or one quiet reminder asks the member to finish or discard it.
who: members who forget to tap Finish
how_often: every forgotten workout with the app closed
fix_line: Give the phone card the one-hour rule too, so it shows Paused and stops counting without the app open
